task.text: How many positive two-digit integers leave a remainder of 2 when divided by 8?

attempts.high: I'm a coroner's office clerk logging case files. Our autopsy backlog uses batch slots of 8 bodies each, and every batch leaves 2 stragglers that overflow into the cold storage annex. For the two-digit case numbers (10 through 99), how many of those would land as the 2-remainder overflow when divided by 8? Need the count for the morgue intake report.
attempts.low: I'm setting up a school carnival and we're arranging the kids into game groups of 8, but we always end up with 2 extra little ones who get to be the "helpers." For the two-digit headcounts (10 through 99), how many would leave exactly 2 helpers when divided by 8? Just need the count for our planning sheet!
